core.title: 17 Inch Warwick Rough Iron Push Plate, Acorn WNDBP
tags: large iron push plates for doors

text.description_html:
Acorn WNDBP, 17" Rough Iron Warwick Push Plate

At 17 inches, this is one of our largest door push plates. It is great for heavy wood or stoneware decor. Its forged crests on both the top and the bottom of the piece will be sure to add old world charm. The rough iron finish duplicates that found on the ironwork of many old European castles and cathedrals and imitates the natural weathering of iron; but unlike antique hardware, Acorn's WNDBP Warwick Push Plate is guaranteed not to rust.

Also Available: Matching Door Pull

Specifications of the Warwick Rough Iron Push Plate:

  • Finish: Rough Black Iron
  • Length: 17"
  • Width: 3-1/4"
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty!

Sold individually. Package includes 1 push plate and hardware for a surfaced mounting application. All dimensions are approximate.
